test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 4(5)/(9) years at the rate of 3.6% per annum is Rs. 5,453. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 2.7% per annum simple interest in 6(2)/(9) years?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Simple Interest** % (1) = 3.6% × 41/9 = 16.4%

Effective **Simple Interest** % (2) = 2.7% × 56/9 = 16.8%

Since 16.4% of Sum = ₹5453, then 1% = 5453 ÷ 16.4 = 332.5

Total **Amount payable** = (100% + 16.8%) = 116.8% of Sum

**Amount** = 116.8 × 332.5 = ₹38836

**∴ The correct answer is ₹38,836.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Case 1:** SI₁ = ₹5453, Time (T₁) = 41/9 years, Rate (R₁) = 3.6%

**Case 2:** Time (T₂) = 56/9 years, Rate (R₂) = 2.7%

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa7ead870dfed3f92bf38812f89144add114274766c4dc2c0886f54056fc66ea.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 5453 = (P × 3.6 × 41/9) ÷ 100

⇒ 5453 = (P × 0.4 × 41) ÷ 100

⇒ 5453 = (P × 16.4) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (5453 × 100) ÷ 16.4 = 33250

⇒ SI₂ = (33250 × 2.7 × 56/9) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = 332.5 × 0.3 × 56

⇒ SI₂ = 332.5 × 16.8 = 5586

⇒ Amount (A₂) = P + SI₂ = 33250 + 5586 = 38836

**∴ The correct answer is ₹38,836.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Properties

Simple interest remains constant for every year if the principal and rate of interest are fixed. It is calculated only on the initial **Principal** amount.

Effective Rate Method

Total Interest % = Rate × Time. This allows direct comparison between different scenarios without calculating the **Principal** first.

Amount in SI

The total amount at the end of the period is the sum of the principal and interest: A = P(1 + RT/100).
